title: ACOG pregnancy dating
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: For day-5 transfer use transfer +261 days; retain ART dating with concordant scans. Applies D032-D052.

title: ASRM fertility evaluation 2021
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: Initiate assessment after twelve months under age 35; evaluate ovulatory status, reproductive anatomy and semen. A progesterone measurement can support ovulation, not luteal quality. D010-D018.

title: ASRM unexplained infertility 2020
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: Usual first treatment is a course of oral stimulation and IUI followed by IVF; synthetic couple elects IVF after alternatives counselling. D018.

title: ASRM ovarian reserve 2020
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: AMH/AFC inform response rather than establishing an infertility cause or predicting an individual live birth. D013-D018.

title: ASRM laboratory operations 2022
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: Written procedure orders, identification, witnessing and recoverable patient reports guide embryology documentation. D025-D032. Does not verify chosen fictional doses.

title: SOGC glucose screening
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: Offer screening at 24-28 weeks; nonfasting 50 g one-hour glucose below 7.8 mmol/L is negative. D042-D045.

title: SOGC GBS patient guidance
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: Culture at 35-37 weeks in cited guidance; synthetic collection at 36+5. D049-D052.

title: Canadian Blood Services maternal testing
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: Initial ABO/RhD and antibody screen, including known Rh-positive pregnancies. D037.

title: Canadian Blood Services oral iron
role: clinical-content rule; not a synthetic PDF layout reference
application: Oral iron can increase hemoglobin/ferritin; intolerance is common and alternate-day use is an evaluated option. Does not prescribe this individual regimen.

title: Ontario HPV programme transition

application: Primary HPV replaced cytology March 3, 2025; distinguish 2022 cytology from 2026 HPV screening. D004, D056, D061-D062.

title: Ontario Health cervical screening

application: HPV-negative average-risk screening returns at five years. D062.
